claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Dipivefrine is a lipophilic epinephrine prodrug that is rapidly hydrolyzed to epinephrine; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it is expected to show little or no selective cytotoxicity, with any weak antiproliferative effect reflecting nonspecific adrenergic/catecholamine-mediated stress rather than a targeted killing mechanism.
